conversation.Statement: Hello, this is Melissa from Amazon Prime Support. I'm calling to help you with a recent Prime account issue. Am I speaking with Mrs. Parker?
Yes, this is Mrs. Parker. Is something wrong with my account?

Thank you for confirming. I noticed that there was an unusual purchase attempt on your Amazon Prime account last night, and it triggered a temporary account lock for your safety. We're here to help resolve this quickly.
Oh no! My son sometimes uses my account, could that have caused it?

That's completely understandable, and it happens often. Our main goal is to protect your account and make sure any unauthorized or accidental purchases are addressed. Can I please confirm the email linked to your Amazon account?
Sure, it's parker.family@email.com.
Thank you, Mrs. Parker. For security, may I also have the phone number associated with your account?
Perfect, thank you. Now, it appears that a gaming console and $300 in digital gift cards were almost purchased. Do you recall authorizing that?
No, I never bought those! Maybe my son tried, but I didn't approve anything.

I understand, and it's very common with families. What we'll do is cancel those unauthorized transactions and ensure your account remains secure. Can you please confirm your full name for our records?
It's Caroline Parker.
Thank you, Mrs. Parker. I'm going to send a verification code to your phone number. Could you please read it back to me once you get it?
Okay, I just got a text. The code is 849101.

That's exactly what I needed. Now, to finalize the cancellation and unlock your account, Amazon has a temporary security policy. Because the attempted purchase was for high-value items, a refundable hold of $298.97 is required to verify the rightful account holder. I'll walk you through the process, it's quick and you'll receive the funds back right after.
A hold? I don't really understand. Why do I have to pay anything if I didn't buy those things?

Absolutely, and I know it can sound confusing. This is simply a temporary step to confirm you're the authorized user. Once we verify, the hold is instantly refunded. It's a security measure Amazon uses to stop fraudulent purchases before they go through.
Okay. How do I do this hold?

Right now, the fastest and most secure method is with Amazon gift cards. You can purchase them at any local store, like Walgreens, CVS, or Walmart. Once you have the cards, I'll show you how to apply them for the refundable hold.
Gift cards? That seems strange. Why can't I just use my card on the website?

I completely understand your concern. We use gift cards as a temporary security deposit since they process instantly and are easier to refund in case of accidental charges. This method is recommended by our security department for urgent account holds.
I just want to make sure my account isn't charged forever. This will be refunded, right?

Absolutely, Mrs. Parker. As soon as the security check is complete, your $298.97 will be refunded to your Amazon balance or your card, whichever you prefer. I'll stay with you throughout the process so you're never alone.
Okay, I'll go to the store now. Do I just buy three $100 Amazon gift cards?
Exactly, three $100 Amazon gift cards will cover the hold amount. Please keep the receipts, and once you have the cards, call us back at this number or I can stay on the line if you prefer.
I'd rather you stay on the line, I get nervous about these things.
That's no problem at all, I'm here to help. When you have the cards, I'll simply ask you for the codes on the back to verify the hold. The process only takes a few minutes.
Alright, I just bought the cards. What do I do next?
Great job, Mrs. Parker. Now, please carefully scratch off the silver strip on the back of each card and read me the claim codes, starting with the first card.
Okay, the first code is X7F9-8LKQ-GR21.
Thank you. And the second card's code, please?
It's 9P2H-L6TQ-39VD.
Perfect, thank you. And the last one?
Here it is: G5JR-4TY7-2WQX.

Thank you, Mrs. Parker, you've done everything correctly. The codes are being verified and as soon as the check completes, the hold amount will be refunded to your original payment method. This usually takes about 30 to 60 minutes.
Okay, I'm going to keep an eye on my account. Should I do anything else?

You're all set for now. If you see any unexpected charges or have questions, just give us a call. We appreciate your cooperation and want to make sure your Amazon experience remains safe and positive.
